profile.headline: Full Stack Developer at IT Crowd Argentina
profile.summary:
I am passionate about learning new and different things.

I started learning about web programming in 2014 thanks to a very awesome group of young developers in my university. They introduced me to HTML, CSS, and javascript and then showed me the ropes on back-end development with ruby on rails.

That same year I joined Insignia, a Ruby on Rails software factory, as a backend developer. I got the opportunity to work on several different projects for clients from all around the world, writing applications for project management, a booking venue system, an NYC nightlife app, among others.

Some projects from that era: Safely, Infohu, TuCancha, TableHopping, HappyHourMonster, Inksy, Celectiv, Trade-a-grape, guguguru.

In late 2015 I started my career as a freelance developer together with the Devignis team, where I focused on expanding my experience with different tools for my frontend stack such as Ionic, Vue, React, and React-Native, and also getting more experience in my ruby backend stack with projects that needed features over elastic-search, Redis, ActionCable, a custom implementation of ActiveAdmin and some other custom engines/gems.

Some projects from that era: Keylo, Hire-Society, Numgames, Edge-Up, Canopy Cloud, HomeActions.

Recently I've been working on projects within the Rails+React stack, coding personal projects and different proof of concept applications.

In 2021 I joined IT Crowd Argentina as a full-stack developer, and I'm currently working on a Next.js project
